title: Publish Unity Gateway Skills with a GitHub Action in Beta
body: Publish Git-managed skills to Unity Catalog with a GitHub Action in [Beta](/aws/en/release-notes/release-types). Map folders to skills and publish updates on merges to your publishing branch. See [Publish skills from your GitHub repository](/aws/en/agents/uc-skills/create-share-uc-skills#publish-skills-from-your-github-repository).

ref_links.text: Publish skills from your GitHub repository
